# ZK scopes (rendered from source)

A gate proves under exactly one registered scope; the mapping is fixed in `lib/zk/prove.ts`, never chosen by a caller. The scope string has the form `layers/zk-scope/v1|feature|epoch|persona` — the persona segment is what keeps two personas of one root from sharing a nullifier, and it is omitted only for the anonymous-post claim, which is one-per-root-per-window by design.

| Claim kind | Scope |
|---|---|
| `tier-membership` | `discovery-tier` |
| `fork-continuity` | `fork-continuity` |
| `attestation` | `attestation` |
| `anon-post` | `anon-post` |
| `persona-launch` | `persona-launch` |
| `x-anon-post` | `x-anon-post` |

What each claim carries beyond the scope is in the `ProveRequest` interface of the same file (fork commitment, issuer and bucket, cast hash and attribution commitment).
